title: Beasts of Aethelgard – Magical Specializations
content:
Magical specializations have given rise to creatures with abilities unmatched by any earth animal.

Glimmer spiders from Glimmerdark spin webs glowing with captured bioluminescence. Their silk is prized by dark elf alchemists for its light-accumulating properties, and by surface weavers for its unearthly beauty—but harvesting it requires negotiation with the spiders, who are intelligent enough to distinguish trade from theft.

Fire bats from the Ashlands consume volcanic gases and exhale heat. Their colonies warm caves that would otherwise be uninhabitable. Federation settlements near such colonies have learned to leave offerings of sulfur in exchange for the bats' tolerance.

Frost snakes from Wintergard leave trails of ice in their wake; Their bodies are so cold that touching them causes instant frostbite. Dark elf hunters hunt them for their scales, which they use to weave cloaks that render the wearer invisible to heat-seeing predators.
